name: Immoral Little DS
source:
The protagonist, Kazuma Kisakata, was working as a temporary dorm supervisor at the private Hasuikenan Academy (nicknamed "Hasunan"), taking full charge of cleaning, laundry, meal prep for club members, night shifts, and other dorm duties.  

Then came April—and with it, two girls moved in, turning his life completely upside down.  
While cleaning the room of one of the girls, Sae, he accidentally stumbled upon her underwear.  
Just as he picked it up, misfortune struck—Sae herself caught him in the act, branding him a panty thief.  

"Keep quiet and do as I say," Sae ordered, turning Kazuma into her personal plaything.  

But that wasn't the end of it—the other girl, Nonoka, happened to walk in on them...  
Between the two of them, they dragged out his innermost masochistic nature.  
And so began his twisted new life.  
As the new school term settled into a steady rhythm, with studies no longer a pressing concern—  
Sae and Nonoka, though restless with jealousy at the thought of Kazuma's eyes wandering, schemed on how to tempt him further—especially after seeing his reaction to their school swimsuits.  
Kazuma would be teased, bullied, and utterly drained.  
To be stepped on, scolded, toyed with, degraded—  
Every moment with them was a fulfillment of his deepest desires.

[Translated from [url=https://www.digiket.com/work/show/_data/ID=ITM0081923/]Digiket[/url]]
translation:
主人公木坂和真在私立莲水南学园（绰号“莲水”）担任临时宿舍管理员，全面负责清洁、洗衣、为社团成员准备膳食、夜班等宿舍事务。

然后是四月——随之而来的是两个女孩搬了进来，彻底改变了他的生活。
在打扫其中一名女孩Sae的房间时，他不小心发现了她的内衣。
就在他拿起它时，不幸降临了——Sae本人当场抓住了他，并给他贴上了内裤贼的标签。

“保持安静，按我说的做。”纱耶命令道，把和真变成了她的私人玩物。

但这并没有结束——另一个女孩，诺诺卡，碰巧走进了他们……  
两人之间，将他内心深处的受虐狂拽了出来。
就这样开始了他扭曲的新生活。
随着新学期步入平稳的节奏，学习不再是一个紧迫的问题——  
纱江和野乃香虽然一想到和真眼神游移而嫉妒得坐立不安，但还是计划着如何进一步诱惑他——尤其是在看到他对学校泳衣的反应后。
和真会被嘲笑、被欺负，甚至被彻底耗尽。
被人踩、被骂、被玩、被贬——  
与他们在一起的每一刻都是他最深切愿望的实现。
